privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.content:
Privacy Policy — Korrect Cars

Effective date: 12 July 2026

Korrect Cars ("we", "our", "us") operates the website korrectcars.com. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose and safeguard your information when you visit our website or purchase a vehicle from us. By using our website you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.

1. Information we collect

We collect the following categories of information:

  • Personal information you provide: name, email address, phone number, delivery address, government-issued ID (for BNPL and delivery), and any details you send us via forms, WhatsApp or email.
  • Automatically collected information: IP address, browser type, device type, referring URL, pages visited, time spent on the site and click activity. This is collected via cookies and standard log files.
  • Payment information: we do not store card or bank details on our servers. Payments are handled by third-party processors that meet PCI-DSS standards.

2. How we use your information

  • To respond to enquiries and reserve vehicles you have expressed interest in.
  • To operate our Buy-Now-Pay-Later financing and doorstep delivery services.
  • To improve our website, inventory listings and customer service.
  • To send you transactional messages (order confirmations, delivery updates) and, only with your consent, occasional marketing.
  • To comply with applicable Nigerian and international law.

3. Cookies and tracking

We use cookies and similar technologies to remember your preferences, understand how you use korrectcars.com, and measure the effectiveness of our marketing. This includes Google Analytics (measurement ID G-T3H426CGY9) and, where enabled, Google AdSense to serve advertisements. Google AdSense may use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to our website or other websites. You can opt out of personalised advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings. You may also disable cookies via your browser settings, though some site features may not work as intended.

4. Sharing of information

We do not sell your personal information. We may share limited information with:

  • Delivery and logistics partners to complete your vehicle delivery.
  • Finance partners who process your BNPL application.
  • Service providers who host, secure or analyse our website (e.g. hosting, analytics).
  • Law enforcement or regulators where legally required.

5. Data security

We use industry-standard technical and organisational measures — HTTPS across the entire site, encrypted backups, access controls and two-factor authentication for staff accounts — to protect your data. No transmission over the internet is 100% secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security, but we work continually to keep your information safe.

6. Your rights

Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to access, correct, delete or restrict processing of your personal information; to withdraw consent; and to object to marketing. To exercise any of these rights, email us at info@korrectcars.com. We respond within 30 days.

7. Children

Korrect Cars is not directed at children under 18 and we do not knowingly collect information from them. If you believe a child has provided us information, contact us and we will delete it.

8. Third-party links

Our website may contain links to third-party sites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of other operators. We recommend reading the privacy policy of each site you visit.

9. Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The updated version will be posted on this page with a revised effective date. Material changes will be communicated via a notice on our website or by email.

10. Contact us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us:

  • Korrect Cars
  • Email: info@korrectcars.com
  • Phone / WhatsApp: +234 809 139 7912
  • Alt. WhatsApp: +234 813 858 8818
  • Service area: Lagos, Nigeria (nationwide delivery)

terms-and-conditions.title: Terms and Conditions
terms-and-conditions.content:
Terms and Conditions — Korrect Cars

Effective date: 12 July 2026

Welcome to Korrect Cars. These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") govern your use of the website korrectcars.com and any related services provided by Korrect Cars ("we", "our", "us"). By accessing or using the website you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

1. About Korrect Cars

Korrect Cars is an online car dealership based in Lagos, Nigeria. We source, verify and sell Tokunbo (foreign-used), Nigerian-used and new vehicles, and we offer Buy-Now-Pay-Later financing, pre-purchase inspection and nationwide doorstep delivery services.

2. Vehicle listings

We take care to ensure that vehicle information on the website — including make, model, year, mileage, VIN, condition and pricing — is accurate at the time of listing. Photos are of the actual vehicle. Prices are quoted in Nigerian Naira and are subject to change without notice. Availability is confirmed on request; a listing does not constitute a binding offer.

3. Reservations and purchases

A vehicle is considered reserved only when we confirm the reservation in writing (email or WhatsApp) and receive an agreed reservation fee. Full transfer of title occurs on receipt of the balance in cleared funds (for cash purchases) or completion of the BNPL agreement.

4. Buy-Now-Pay-Later (BNPL)

BNPL is offered subject to approval, background checks and signed agreement. Down payment amount, interest rate, tenure and default consequences are set out in each individual BNPL contract. Missed payments may result in repossession in accordance with Nigerian law and the terms of the specific agreement.

5. Inspection, warranty and disclaimers

Every vehicle undergoes a multi-point inspection before listing. We disclose known defects. Except where expressly stated in writing, vehicles are sold "as inspected"; used vehicles do not carry a manufacturer warranty unless the original warranty is still active. Optional extended warranties may be arranged through third-party providers.

6. Delivery

Nationwide doorstep delivery is offered in Nigeria. Delivery timing depends on destination, road conditions and paperwork status. Risk of loss transfers to the buyer once the vehicle is signed for at delivery.

7. Payment

We accept bank transfers to Korrect Cars accounts, and (where explicitly enabled) approved online payment gateways. Cash payments must be documented with a signed receipt. Payments to any account other than an official Korrect Cars account are not authorised.

8. Intellectual property

All content on korrectcars.com — including text, logos, photos and vehicle descriptions — is the property of Korrect Cars or its licensors. You may not copy, distribute, or exploit any content commercially without our prior written permission.

9. User conduct

You agree not to use the website to post or transmit any material that is unlawful, threatening, abusive, defamatory, obscene, or that infringes any third-party rights; to attempt to gain unauthorised access to our systems; or to interfere with the proper working of the website.

10. Third-party services and advertising

Our website may display advertisements served by Google AdSense and other third-party advertising networks, and may embed content from third parties. We do not endorse and are not responsible for the accuracy of advertisements or third-party content.

11. Limitation of liability

To the fullest extent permitted by Nigerian law, Korrect Cars will not be liable for indirect, consequential or punitive damages arising from your use of the website or purchase of a vehicle. Our total liability in respect of any purchase is limited to the amount paid for that vehicle.

12. Governing law

These Terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria. Any dispute arising out of or in connection with these Terms will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Lagos State.

13. Changes to these Terms

We may update these Terms from time to time. The revised version will be posted on this page with an updated effective date. Continued use of the website after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

14. Contact

  • Korrect Cars
  • Email: info@korrectcars.com
  • Phone / WhatsApp: +234 809 139 7912
  • Alt. WhatsApp: +234 813 858 8818
  • Service area: Lagos, Nigeria (nationwide delivery)

about-us.title: About Korrect Cars
about-us.content:
Cars sold the right way. Online. In Nigeria.

Korrect Cars is a Nigerian online dealership built for the way people actually buy cars today: from their phone, on their time, without wondering whether the mileage is real. Every vehicle is inspected, VIN-verified and priced right, from foreign-used tokunbo to certified pre-owned to brand-new imports.

VIN-verified

Every vehicle's VIN is decoded and history-checked before we list it. No mystery paperwork, no invented specs.

Nationwide reach

Online-first means we are not tied to one showroom. We arrange viewings anywhere in Lagos and support buyers across Nigeria.

Real cars. Real prices. Real support.

We source vehicles to match what buyers actually want. Every listing is the truth: VIN decoded, mileage disclosed, condition documented, and real photos of the actual car. If it has a scratch, you will see the scratch.

Multi-point inspection

Every certified pre-owned vehicle passes a full inspection: engine, transmission, suspension, brakes, electrical and bodywork.

Book a viewing

Found a car you like? Book a viewing at a location that works for you. We bring the car; you bring the questions.

Three ways to own

Buy outright, Pay Small Small with 40% down and up to 48 months to pay, or swap your current car with a verified owner on Korrect Swap.

The Korrect Cars promise: we treat every sale like it is our own money on the line.

faqs.q: Are all vehicles inspected before sale?
faqs.a: Yes. Every vehicle listed on Korrect Cars is VIN-verified and passes our multi-point inspection covering engine, transmission, brakes, suspension, electrical and bodywork before we publish it. Certified Pre-owned vehicles get a full documented inspection report available on request.

faqs.q: Do you offer financing or Buy Now Pay Later?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with financing partners so you can Drive Now, Pay Later with flexible monthly instalments up to 12 months, or spread smaller payments daily/weekly with our Pay Small Small option. Reach out via WhatsApp or the Contact page to see what fits your budget.

faqs.q: Do the cars come with a warranty?
faqs.a: Certified Pre-owned vehicles come with an inspection-backed guarantee and, on request, an extended mechanical warranty. Foreign-used (Tokunbo) and Nigerian-used vehicles are sold as-inspected — full condition report shared before you commit.

faqs.q: How do test drives work if you do not have a showroom?
faqs.a: We are online-first, so we bring the vehicle to a viewing location that works for you across Lagos (or arrange a nearby appointment for buyers in other cities). You inspect the car, test-drive it, and only proceed if you love it.
Yes. We support buyers across Nigeria. After payment we can arrange nationwide delivery via a trusted logistics partner — full cost is quoted based on your destination.

faqs.q: What documents will I receive with my vehicle?
faqs.a: You receive the original title/custom papers, ownership transfer documents, inspection report (for Certified vehicles), and any available service history. We walk you through registration and re-titling if needed.

faqs.q: Can I sell my current car through Korrect Cars?
faqs.a: Yes. Send us the VIN, current mileage, photos, and your asking price via WhatsApp or the Contact page. If it fits our inventory we will list it, market it, and handle inquiries — we take a small commission on the sale.

faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: Bank transfer (recommended) and cashiers cheque for full vehicle purchases. For financed purchases the payment schedule is handled with our finance partner. We do not accept cash for full payments.
